_why: The studio's asset library: every reusable component with toki's verdict (her words, verbatim, dated) and its open notes. A new package reuses toki-liked / approved parts first and gives each one something NEW in that video (never a copy of the last video's look). status: toki-liked (she praised it) | approved (in a video she approved / uploaded, no complaint) | open (in use, but she named a fault - fix before reuse) | new (built, toki has not seen it yet). Update this file whenever toki judges a video (raymi next: the final / thumbs steps).
